mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[tool:pytest]
# Project-level pytest configuration.
# This file is needed because mutmut runs pytest from a temp workdir and
# only copies setup.cfg (not pyproject.toml) into it. The pytest-asyncio
# plugin is required by FR-08's async tests, and the framework's
# PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 default means we must explicitly
# request it via -p asyncio in addopts. pytest-benchmark is requested the
# same way and for the same reason: NFR-01's two budget tests
# (03-development/tests/test_nfr01_perf.py) take the `benchmark` fixture,
# so without -p benchmark every mutmut run would error on a missing
# fixture and score every mutant as killed.
addopts = -p asyncio -p benchmark
asyncio_mode = auto
filterwarnings =
    ignore::DeprecationWarning
    ignore::UserWarning

# Project-level pytest configuration.
# This file is at the project root so pytest picks it up from anywhere
# in the tree (e.g. mutmut's runner that uses `python3 -m pytest ...`).
asyncio_mode = "auto"
markers = [
    "asyncio: Mark async test functions for pytest-asyncio (STRICT mode fallback).",
]
filterwarnings = [
    "ignore::DeprecationWarning",
    "ignore::UserWarning",
]

[tool.mypy]
# advance-phase runs `mypy . --ignore-missing-imports --exclude ^harness/`.
# This block tells mypy to skip the tests/ tree too — pytest test files
# are not part of the production surface that gate 2's type-safety
# dimension (pyright errorCount=0 over 28 src files) measured. Tests
# are still checked by ruff and pytest.
exclude = ["^harness/", "^03-development/tests/"]
